title: A four-element two-torsion subgroup has sum zero
statement: Let G be an additive commutative group with decidable equality. Let T be a finite subset of G such that x belongs to T if and only if 2 • x = 0, using natural-number repeated addition. If T has exactly four elements, then the sum of its elements is zero.
lean_statement: ∀ (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [DecidableEq G] (T : Finset G), (∀ x : G, x ∈ T ↔ (2 : ℕ) • x = 0) → T.card = 4 → T.sum (fun x => x) = 0
